purpose: Deterministically harvest explicit dependencies and source-carrying evidence fragments from the frozen 488-JSON Egyptian corpus into a provenance-preserving graph without inventing cultural lineage or ancient semantics.

input_contract.allowed_inputs: Only paths enumerated in the frozen 488-entry inventory.
input_contract.sha_rule: Every source byte stream must match the inventory SHA-256 before parsing.
input_contract.parse_rule: Every frozen source must remain valid JSON; hash mismatch, missing file, or parse failure aborts the gate.

provenance_first_rule.rule: Ancient-source/function/form evidence without a same-file provenance anchor cannot be promoted above UNVERIFIED_SPECULATION.

confounder_isolation.egyptian_revival: Explicit Egyptian Revival/decorative-modern-borrowing evidence is isolated as SPURIOUS_REVIVAL_EDGE and never counted as ancient-to-modern transmission.
confounder_isolation.visual_analogy: Visual resemblance or co-occurrence alone creates no cultural-lineage edge.

evidence_fragment_rule.representation: JSON leaf plus JSON Pointer plus source file SHA-256
evidence_fragment_rule.raw_value_policy: Store selected raw leaf text up to a fixed deterministic display cap and always store full raw-value SHA-256.
evidence_fragment_rule.classification: Layer assignment is lexical/path-based and may be multi-label; it is indexing, not historical interpretation.
evidence_fragment_rule.dependency_rule: Artifact/file/commit edges require explicit string references in source JSON; shared keywords never create dependency edges.

determinism.stable_ids: SHA-256 derived from immutable source identifiers and JSON Pointers
determinism.graph_core_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing sorted nodes and edges only

pass_conditions: all 488 source SHA-256 values match inventory
all 488 source files parse as JSON
graph contains the seven schema layers
every evidence fragment retains source path, source SHA-256 and JSON Pointer
no inferred cultural-lineage edge is created from co-occurrence alone
fail_conditions: any missing or hash-drifted frozen source
any JSON parse failure among frozen 488 inputs
non-deterministic duplicate node or conflicting stable id
automatic promotion of resemblance to direct lineage
canonical_seal: HARVEST DEPENDENCIES AND EVIDENCE, NOT DESIRED STORIES. EVERY CLAIM CARRIES ITS SOURCE POINTER; RESEMBLANCE NEVER BECOMES LINEAGE BY AUTOMATION.
